title: Narrative Feature Schema v1
description: LLM response schema for per-scene narrative feature extraction.

pacing.description: Narrative speed, event progression, and momentum.

dialogue_density.description: Proportion and importance of spoken dialogue.

action_density.description: Physical action, external events, movement, confrontation, or concrete incident density.

character_interaction.description: Density and centrality of character-to-character exchange or relational movement.

emotion_intensity.description: Affective intensity, tension, distress, intimacy, anger, fear, joy, or dramatic charge.
